scientific_intent.scientific_task: Apply distinct dense square matrices to a batch of independent vectors.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each batch, C=A*B with alpha1,beta0 and n=1 under padded column-major strides.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Independent small dense matrices and vectors; no source-specific physical mesh or PDE.
invariants: Each output row equals its matrix-row/vector dot product.
Inactive padded output positions retain zero under the study reset contract.
accuracy_requirements: All8192 output positions, including4096 active results and4096 zero padding values, finite and within absolute1e-6 against CPU and both GPU references.
This matches the native Float64 verification criterion; native half/single precision accuracy is not inferred.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 dot accumulation and vendor summation order; bounded non-dyadic inputs exercise rounding without changing precision.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: m=k32,n1,ld64,batch128; original dimension sweep and25000batch default unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Generic batched linear algebra primitive. Source alone does not identify a particular simulation, inference model or application dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Opaque cuBLAS implementation details and other precision-mode behavior remain unknown.
